symptoms: Massive PE: Hypotension (SBP < 90 mmHg), syncope, obstructive shock, acute RV strain
Non-massive PE: Dyspnoea, pleuritic chest pain, haemoptysis, tachycardia

management_steps.details:
Weight >= 65kg: 10mg IV bolus, then 90mg IV infusion over 2 hours.
Weight < 65kg: Total dose 1.5mg/kg (10mg IV bolus, remainder over 2 hours).
Cardiac Arrest: 50mg IVI STAT.
